steps.name: Install normal pinned tools and compiler isolation within the aggregate
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from tools.build_process import run_bounded_result
from tools.build_observation import build_environment
root=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'typescript-global-buffer-bootstrap'
root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
started=int(os.environ['LSF_BUFFER_GLOBAL_STARTED_NS'])
commands=[
  [sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--requirement','tools/requirements.lock'],
  ['sudo','apt-get','update'],
  ['sudo','apt-get','install','--yes','bubblewrap'],
  ['sudo','sysctl','-w','kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0'],
  [sys.executable,'tools/typescript_capsule.py','install-tools',str(Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'typescript-global-buffer-tools')],
]
for command in commands:
  remaining=1200-(time.time_ns()-started)/1e9-10
  if remaining<=0:raise RuntimeError('buffer-globals-bootstrap-deadline')
  result=run_bounded_result(command,Path.cwd(),build_environment(root),timeout_seconds=min(300,remaining),max_output_bytes=4*1024**2)
  sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout);sys.stderr.buffer.write(result.stderr)
  if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('buffer-globals-bootstrap-command')
PY
